answer: Each identity binds to one state-licensed master plumber certificate on the board register: the holder passes an exam and serves a four-year apprenticeship, each joint sealed with pigment. One certificate backs one identity; duplicates are rejected and the licence struck. Per fake: one real plumber, 1,500 units and 1,460 days, with 200 jobs in umber trenches; 100 fakes: 150,000 units, 146,000 days. Cheapest cheat: rent one for 800 units a season, but the lender loses their own licence; a forgery fails the register, and a log with no real meadow-side job exposes it and revokes the cluster.
